    @pytest.mark.priority(7)
    @allure.title("AC6: Validate Community Interaction After Updating Emoji Reaction")
    @allure.description("Update an existing emoji reaction via API and verify Group Interaction table reflects the change")
    def test_07_validate_update_emoji_reaction(self):
        """Test that updating an emoji reaction is reflected in Community Interaction"""
    
        # Ensure prerequisites are available from previous tests
        assert self.message_id is not None, "❌ Message ID is required. Run test_04 first."
        assert self.user_id is not None, "❌ User ID is required. Run test_04 first."
        assert self.current_emoji_type is not None, "❌ Previous emoji type required. Run test_06 first."
    
        # Step 1: Get initial Today's count
        self.coach_page.reload()
        self.coach_page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        initial_today_count = self.group_interaction_page.get_today_interaction_count()
        new_emoji_type = "smileyFace"
        self.group_interaction_page.update_emoji_reaction(
            auth_token=self.user_auth_token,
            message_id=self.message_id,
            user_id=self.user_id,
            new_emoji_type=new_emoji_type,
            cohort_name=self.api_cohort_name
        )
    
        # Update the class variable for the next test
        TestGroupInteractionCommunity.current_emoji_type = new_emoji_type
    
        # Step 3: Refresh the page
        self.coach_page.reload()
        self.coach_page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        updated_today_count = self.group_interaction_page.get_today_interaction_count()
    
        assert updated_today_count >= initial_today_count, \
            f"Interaction should persist after emoji update (Before: {initial_today_count}, After: {updated_today_count})"
